title: Apartment for rent
body:
## Apartment for rent — Maple Street

Are you a student? This is the apartment for you! It's a small, bright apartment near the university.

There are two bedrooms. Each bedroom has a bed, a desk and a big closet. There's one bathroom with a shower.

The kitchen is new. There's a fridge, a stove and a microwave, but there isn't a dishwasher. The living room has a gray sofa, an armchair and a TV. There are two big windows, so the apartment is very sunny.

There isn't a yard, but there's a small balcony with plants.

The rent is $850 a month. No pets, please.

Call Mr. Ortiz: 555-0182 (afternoons only).
